items.title: Sustainable AI: Tools, frameworks and best practices in 2026
items.summary: Sustainability professionals are scrambling to understand how AI adoption will impact environmental goals.

items.title: New tool helps Etsy peer into the ‘black box’ of AI emissions
items.summary: Sustainable AI Group, the company co-founded by former Salesforce sustainability manager Boris Gamazaychikov, has released a resource for measuring the energy and emissions produced by proprietary artificial intelligence models.

items.title: New emissions accounting rules win backing from companies and nonprofits
items.summary: Plans for a major expansion of how companies report emissions have won widespread support from the public and private sector.

items.title: ONE WEEK TO GO: The Autumn Budget – How businesses can cut waste, control costs and prepare for 2027
items.summary: In one week edie will host its latest webinar, in partnership with JRP Solutions, exploring how businesses can cut waste, control costs and plan effectively for the year ahead.

items.title: Recycled polyester to enter Primark clothing from 2029
items.summary: Primark has agreed a multi-year deal with textile recycling company Circ to introduce recycled polyester made from textile waste into its clothing from 2029.

items.title: Government launches Great British Grid to invest in electricity network
items.summary: The UK Government has announced the creation of Great British (GB) Grid, a publicly owned body within GB Energy that will invest in electricity network infrastructure and work with existing network operators to accelerate grid upgrades.

items.title: Win a free VIP pass to edie 27: Take our sustainability snapshot survey
items.summary: Sustainability professionals have the chance to win six months of access to edie’s digital Membership offering as well as a VIP pass to edie 27 in April by completing a short survey.

items.title: SPEAKERS ANNOUNCED: What SMEs need to know before investing in solar
items.summary: Two expert speakers have been confirmed for an upcoming edie webinar exploring how SMEs can overcome the financial and practical barriers to onsite solar and maximise the return on their investment.

items.title: edie named official media partner of Carbon Accounting Conference 2026
items.summary: edie is delighted to announce that we are the official media partner of the 2026 Carbon Accounting Conference, taking place on 6 October.

items.title: What 10 years of locally led innovation has taught Unilever
items.summary: Unilever's vice president of global sustainability, Rianne Buter, explains how working with local impact enterprises can help businesses test and scale solutions that bring both commercial value and positive social impact.
